title: 3.x ORM issue with order() and prepared statement bindings
body:
Use Case:
UNION ALL of 2 select statements, ORDER BY the combined union result, both union parts feature different SQL functions (if soundex matches, return union_table_order = 1, if levenshtein matches return union_table_order 2)
Ref: https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/issues/7157#issuecomment-127014553

Reduced case:

``` php
    public function findAddressWithSimilarStreet($street)
    {
        $queryA = $this->find();
        $queryA->where(['SOUNDEX(LOWER(street))' => $queryA->func()->SOUNDEX([$street])]); // SQL error if I remove this. See below 1st comment.
        $queryB = $this->find(); // This used to be levenshtein query, now this is a dummy query to show the issue.
        $queryC = $this->find(); // This is the outer query used to combine the union into a new query to be able to ORDER BY on the union table result.
        $queryClevenshteinFunc = $queryC->func()->levenshtein([$street, 'LOWER(Geodata__street)' => 'literal']);
        $orderExp = $queryC->newExpr()->add($queryClevenshteinFunc)->add('ASC')->type(' ');
        $queryC->select(['Geodata__street' => 'Geodata__street'])
            ->from(['Geodata' => $queryA->unionAll($queryB)])
            ->order($orderExp) // outcomment this => query works
        ;
        return $queryC;
    }
```

**ERROR:**
SQLSTATE[HY093]: Invalid parameter number: number of bound variables does not match number of tokens

`debug($queryC);` : 

